mapper.select: SELECT bsi.inbound_id, po.po_no, DATE_FORMAT(bsi.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS received_at, COUNT(DISTINCT bsid.inbound_detail_id) AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(bsid.qty * IFNULL(m.material_price, 0)), 0) AS total_amount FROM branch_stock_inbound bsi JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.hq_outbound_no = bsi.hq_outbound_no JOIN place_order po ON po.po_no = ho.po_no JOIN branch_stock_inbound_detail bsid ON bsid.inbound_id = bsi.inbound_id JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_stock_code = bsid.branch_stock_code JOIN material m ON m.material_code = bs.material_code WHERE bsi.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND DATE(bsi.received_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(bsi.received_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY bsi.inbound_id, po.po_no, bsi.received_at ORDER BY bsi.received_at DESC, bsi.inbound_id DESC

SELECT bsi.inbound_id, po.po_no, DATE_FORMAT(bsi.received_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS received_at, COUNT(DISTINCT bsid.inbound_detail_id) AS item_count, COALESCE(SUM(bsid.qty * IFNULL(m.material_price, 0)), 0) AS total_amount FROM branch_stock_inbound bsi JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.hq_outbound_no = bsi.hq_outbound_no JOIN place_order po ON po.po_no = ho.po_no JOIN branch_stock_inbound_detail bsid ON bsid.inbound_id = bsi.inbound_id JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_stock_code = bsid.branch_stock_code JOIN material m ON m.material_code = bs.material_code WHERE bsi.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND po.po_no = #{poNo} GROUP BY bsi.inbound_id, po.po_no, bsi.received_at LIMIT 1

SELECT bsid.branch_stock_code, mg.group_name AS category_name, m.material_name, bsid.qty AS received_qty, m.unit FROM branch_stock_inbound bsi JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.hq_outbound_no = bsi.hq_outbound_no JOIN place_order po ON po.po_no = ho.po_no JOIN branch_stock_inbound_detail bsid ON bsid.inbound_id = bsi.inbound_id JOIN branch_stock bs ON bs.branch_stock_code = bsid.branch_stock_code JOIN material m ON m.material_code = bs.material_code JOIN material_group mg ON mg.material_group_id = m.material_group_id WHERE bsi.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND po.po_no = #{poNo} ORDER BY bsid.inbound_detail_id ASC
